verdict.rationale: Database Webhooks let developers run Edge Functions automatically on INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE table events, and Cron/Queues extend this to scheduled or async triggers—clear, well-documented database-event-driven functions [supabase-supp-db-webhooks][supabase-docs-37][supabase-docs-8][supabase-supp-cron]. However, the evidence pack contains no explicit documentation of Auth-event triggers (e.g., auth hooks firing functions on sign-up/sign-in), so the auth-event half of the story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: documented Auth Hooks/auth-event-triggered functions, independent/hands-on confirmation of webhook-to-function reliability in production.
